question_cn: 为避免被阿拉伯杀，以下哪种做法最有效？
question_en: What is the most effective way to avoid Arabian mate?

options.text_cn: 用兵围住王，增加防御层数
options.text_en: Surround the king with pawns to add layers of defense

options.text_cn: 让王远离角落和边格，保持足够的逃格
options.text_en: Keep the king away from corners and edges, with enough escape squares

options.text_cn: 把己方的马换掉，防止对方利用马将杀
options.text_en: Trade off your knight so the opponent cannot use one to mate

options.text_cn: 主动出击，进攻对方的王
options.text_en: Launch an attack against the opponent's king

explanation_cn: 阿拉伯杀依赖王被困在角落。让王保持在开阔地带，逃格充足，是最直接的防范方法。用兵围王反而可能减少逃格，增加被将死的风险。
explanation_en: Arabian mate depends on trapping the king near a corner. Keep the king in open space with plenty of escape squares. Surrounding it with pawns can reduce those squares and increase the mating danger.
